title: A Throw That You Can't Curl Up In
text:
A Throw That You Can't Curl Up In. This oversized SUNBEAM ARCTIC PLUSH HEATED THROW (Dusty Blue, TSA8TS-X590-13A00) is really just a small electric blanket with a thick plush cover. The large size means it will cover an adult napping on a couch. However, you can't really curl up in it, because (1) you can feel the wires, and (2) the instructions say NOT to use it bunched up.

The throw provides a lot of warmth, even on the "low" setting. The control is simple to use--you just press the center on/off button to cycle through the settings. The throw turns off automatically after three hours.

The placement of the control makes this throw awkward to use. The control is located partway between the plug at one end of the throw and the plug that goes into the wall socket. To keep the control within reach, you need to keep the entire throw fairly close to the wall socket. (This also keeps you from curling up in it.) The generous size of the throw (which should be a terrific feature) actually makes it hard to get everything lined up just right.

I don't care for the plush cover, which looks kind of cheap. The throw isn't something that I would particularly want to display on a couch or overstuffed chair, even though the dusty blue color is nice.

WARNING NOTE: You should NOT use this throw with a recliner chair, mechanical bed, or any other motorized furniture (because of the danger of catching the electrical cord in the moving parts).

Because this excellent small electric blanket doesn't work well as a throw, I rate it at 3 stars ("It's okay" on the official Amazon scale).
